name: portal-player-collide
comment: WP-3.1b. BlockPortal.onEntityCollidedWithBlock (BlockPortal.java:150-155) calls setInPortal on an entity that rides nothing and carries nothing; EntityPlayer.setInPortal (EntityPlayer.java:811-817) sets timeUntilPortal to 10 while it is above 0, else inPortal. Portal blocks (id 90) filled silently (fill does not notify, so no frame is needed) at x 0..1, y 61..63, z 0; the player (id 0) starts outside at (0.5, 61, -2.5) with timeUntilPortal 20 (EntityPlayer.java:33), is moved into the portal at t 3 and out again at t 8 (set_pos, posY 62.62 = 61 + yOffset). The harness player is an EntityPlayer: only EntityPlayerSP.onLivingUpdate counts timeUntilPortal down or clears inPortal (EntityPlayerSP.java:39-76), so it stays at 10 from the first tick in the portal on: player_state every tick.
